key_points: DOJ cleared Paramount‑Skydance’s Warner Bros. merger, removing a major regulatory hurdle
Company launched a $44‑109B high‑grade bond offering to fund the acquisition, adding significant debt to the balance sheet
Shares rallied 3‑4% on the news, but heavy put buying signals lingering downside concerns
Analysts note $6B of required cost‑savings to make the deal financially viable
Debt‑heavy financing and litigation risk keep the thesis cautious despite short‑term upside
